newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Japan fiscal drag fears abating -Tietmeyer.
newsitem.headline: Japan fiscal drag fears abating -Tietmeyer.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said fears that the Japanese government's economic policies could have a negative impact on growth have subsided.
"We had a new assessment (of the Japanese economy)...fears that fiscal drag could have big negative impact seems to be less now than before," Tietmeyer said.
He also said that there have been fears that fiscal drag could interrupt growth.

He was speaking to reporters in his capacity as chairman of the Group of 10 central bank governors committee following their monthly meeting at the Bank for International Settlements. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
